name: Pontardawe RFC
subtitle: Members' card and club news
promotional_text: Your Pontardawe RFC membership card on your phone and in Apple Wallet, with club news and match-day notices the moment they go out.
description:
The official members' app of Pontardawe RFC, est. 1881.

Your membership card lives on your phone. Show the code at the bar and your members' discount is applied, every time, with no card to carry or lose.

• Your members' card: one tap to show the code at the till, with the screen turned up so it scans first time
• Members' discount on every visit
• See what you have spent, earned and saved
• Club news, fixtures and offers, sent straight to your phone as notifications
• Add your card to Apple Wallet
• Your card on your Apple Watch

Sign in with Apple, Google, your phone, a passkey, or your email address with a one-time code or a password. The app is for club members: if you are not a member yet, ask at the club.

review.notes:
Pontardawe RFC's members' app. Sign-in is for club members only: use the reviewer account in Sign-In Information. The sign-in screen opens on email and password: enter them and tap Sign in. Once signed in: Card shows the member's QR code for the till and the Add to Apple Wallet button (it reads "Wallet added" once the card is in Wallet); Activity lists points earned and spent; the bell at the top right opens club news; Venue has the notifications switch; Account has the member's details, sign-out and account deletion. Notifications are sent by the club from its back office, so none may arrive during review.

Payments: the app sells no digital goods. Pontardawe RFC membership is a real-world service (entry to and members' discounts at the clubhouse in Pontardawe), so where the club offers it, joining or renewing is paid by card in the club's card processor's (Dojo) own secure checkout inside the app, as Guidelines 3.1.3(e) and 3.1.5(a) allow for goods and services used outside the app. The reviewer account needs no payment.

testflight.description: The Pontardawe RFC members' app: the membership card with its QR code for the till, Add to Apple Wallet, club news and notifications, and the card on Apple Watch.
testflight.what_to_test: Sign in with a member's email and password (the screen opens on it), or tap Email me a code / Text me a code. Check the card and its QR code at the till, Add to Apple Wallet on the Card page (then "Wallet added"), Activity, adding a mobile number under Account (the code from the text fills in by itself from the keyboard), turning notifications on (Venue) and receiving one sent from the back office, and the card on a paired Apple Watch.
